comment: The TIME jacks are inverted: DLDChannel.hh:121-124 map -5V to full scale and +5V to zero, so a rising voltage shortens the delay. The CLOCK OUT jack carries channel B's clock only (DLDCore.cc:136-137), and the ping button's light follows channel B as well. OUT A is a mono sum when OUT B is unpatched (DLDCore.cc:132-133). The crossfade menu's millisecond labels come from sample counts at DLDChannel.hh:192-193, scaled for the running sample rate, and 1ms is in fact a single sample. Seventeen of the thirty-two parameters are alt parameters with no panel widget (DLD_info.hh:40-56), so they appear only on the right-click menu.
